nom: First Aid Beauty Ingrown Hair Pads with BHA + AHA

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive are split: several say the pads worked with no burning, stinging, or dryness, including on eczema-prone skin, while multiple low-rated reviews report burning, redness, or worsened razor burn on sensitive skin.

concerns.redness: Most reviewers say the pads calm razor-related redness and bumps within days of consistent use, but several of the lowest-rated reviews describe the opposite: increased burning and redness, including one reviewer who needed ice packs after a single application.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report that dark marks and hyperpigmentation left by old ingrown hairs faded with regular use, though one says the pads did not touch discoloration unrelated to ingrown hairs and asked for a dedicated brightening version.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with cystic body acne says the pads dried out active breakouts without leaving dark scars, but another reports the opposite: a pad seemed to bring on new pimples rather than clear them.

aspects.libelle: Individual pads are small for the area
Raised texture adds light physical exfoliation
Brief stinging on freshly shaved skin

extraits.texte: I had high hopes for these since they had pretty good reviews but I do not recommend at all. I used as directed to the T. I still broke out badly from razor burn if not worsened my razor burn. It also burned when I put the product on my razor bumps. I have sensitive skin and I haven't found anything that works for me for razor bumps..):

I've tried many products for ingrown hair and these work the least best of everything I've tried. They don't even reduce redness or promote smoothness and soft skin of any kind. Literally like rubbing alcohol on your sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The size and quantity is nice, I still don't understand the use I've used a couple a times and seems to promote pimples instead of doing the opposite

I'm gonna be honest, I have struggled with cystic butt acne for as long as I can remember and am constantly trying to find things to help Tone it down (I mean like angry pustules not typical acne) and this product is a godsend, it soothed and dried out the current active spots without turning them into dark acne scars!! Spots that left alone would have taken at least a week to heal only took about two days (using Morning and night) and this is so cheap for the payoff I can't recommend this enough I'm amazed

I regularly get my underarms and brazilian waxed and would get horrible ingrowns deep in the skin even with exfoliating and using a good body wash. My waxer recommended this product and the kp scrub and its completely solved my ingrown problem. Ive even put firnds and family onto these products because of how amazing and fast they work. Only way the wipes could be even better is if they had a brightening version as aside from ingrowns, I have discoloration that just wont go away. Please make a brightening version!!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wax and pluck my underarm and lower legs fairly often and am always worried about ingrown hair. I used to use liquid exfoliant and scrub but now that I have discovered these ingrown hair pads, I will be using these from now on. They are so soft, soaked but not dripping. One pad lasts for 1.5 lower legs for me so for the underarms and lower legs (areas of waxing), I only need to use 2 pads. They doesn't cause any irritation on my eczema proned skin (I avoid applying on the eczema flares) and doesn't dry out my skin. The residue is pretty much nonexistent, it doesn't feel dry or uncomfortable and goes really well underneath my moisturizer. The pads have these raised dots that I feel helps the exfoliant goes on better - kinda like a physical exfoliant. The jar is sturdy and small enough that I can bring with me to travel and to my waxing appointments. I used these before and after waxing and they work well. I tried this on my face and it didn't cause any irritation either so I really enjoyed that it is both a face and body exfoliating pad. I will definitely need a bigger jar so it lasts longer.
